SYNC AUDIT — website claims checked against shipped app source.

Every figure, label and chart on repplefitness.com read against the code that ships. Six divergences, each with the file that settles it.

Four are the site overstating the app. One is a genuine bug in the app (two screens print different numbers under the word 'fill'). One is the app disagreeing with itself.

One correction I made mid-audit: 'On track' and 'At risk' DO exist in Coach (analytics.tsx:190) — I had them down as invented until I checked. Only 'drifting' and 'under-loaded' are.

WHAT I DID NOT CHECK.

The app has ~80 screens; this audit covers every claim the four marketing pages make, not every screen.

Not verified: the coach page's 8-week per-client series, and the exact metric and window of the client page's per-exercise chart. Both have plausible counterparts in the app (analytics.tsx, trends.tsx) — I could not confirm the shapes match without reading further, and the toolchain is too degraded right now to be quick about it.

Say the word and I will finish those two.
